sections.text_helper: Section 57.7.11 "TIM15 prescaler (TIM15_PSC)" in chapter 57 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2887.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:0 PSC[15:0]: Prescaler value
The counter clock frequency (ftim_cnt_ck) is equal to ftim_psc_ck / (PSC[15:0] + 1).
PSC contains the value to be loaded in the active prescaler register at each update event
(including when the counter is cleared through UG bit of TIM15_EGR register or through
trigger controller when configured in “reset mode”).
